evidence_summary.binding_rationale: Data filtering, distillation, and synthetic self-play are competition-specific orchestration steps.
Adapter setup is handled by LLM fine-tuning libraries and model-specific configuration.
FlashAttention, paged optimizers, quantization, and precision policy are external training-stack controls.
Adapter routing, merging, and EWC policy are model-level orchestration decisions.
Checkpoint selection, decoding, thresholding, and output formatting are metric-specific.
